controls.label: Number of outcomes n
controls.help: Sets how many leading probability weights are active. It changes S, p_i, c_i, H, Hmax, and R.

controls.label: Probability weights w_i
controls.help: Sets raw weights for outcomes 1 through 8; only the first n are active. It changes S, p_i, c_i, H, and R; Hmax depends only on n.

controls.label: Force equally likely outcomes
controls.help: When on, all n active outcomes receive probability 1/n instead of the weights. It changes S, p_i, c_i, H, and R; Hmax still depends only on n.

explorations.title: Certainty concentrates all probability
explorations.instruction: Predict: what happens to each contribution c_i and to total entropy H when one active outcome has all the weight? Then apply the preset, which sets Number of outcomes n, Probability weights w_i, and Force equally likely outcomes.
explorations.observe: The normalization denominator S is 1. The normalized probabilities p_i are 1 for outcome 1 and 0 for outcomes 2 through 4, so the contributions c_i are 0 for every outcome and the total entropy H is 0 bits. The maximum entropy Hmax is 2 bits and the redundancy R is 2 bits.
explorations.why: With p_1 = 1, the term -p_1 log2 p_1 is -1 log2 1 = 0. The zero probabilities contribute 0 by the convention 0 log2 0 = 0, so no choice remains and H = 0.

explorations.title: Equally likely outcomes reach the maximum
explorations.instruction: Predict: what values do p_i, c_i, H, Hmax, and R take when all four outcomes are equally likely? Then apply the preset, which sets Number of outcomes n, Probability weights w_i, and Force equally likely outcomes.
explorations.observe: The denominator S is 4. The normalized probabilities p_i are 0.25 for the four active outcomes, each contribution c_i is 0.5 bits, the total entropy H is 2 bits, the maximum entropy Hmax is 2 bits, and the redundancy R is 0 bits.
explorations.why: Equal probabilities make each term -0.25 log2 0.25 = 0.5 bits. Summing four equal contributions gives H = log2 4 = 2 bits, so H reaches Hmax and R vanishes.
